rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible" for target record). Record metadata specifies String, Gabrielle M. (2017), "Approaches in Drinking Water Provision in Developing Countries: An Investigation of Water Safety Plans and Ceramic Water Filters", whereas the retrieved PDF is Majuru, Batsirai, Suhrcke, Marc Eckart and Hunter, Paul R. (2016), "How Do Households Respond to Unreliable Water Supplies? A Systematic Review" (IJERPH 13(12):1222, doi:10.3390/ijerph13121222).
